svg.title: matrix.elysium home network
svg.desc: Physical and logical topology of the home network: ISP gateway in bridge mode, the pfSense firewall morpheus, the core switch neo, the 9U rack, and the six VLANs with every addressed host. Drawn from docs/network.md and docs/hardware.md.

g.text: Home network · physical and logical topology · as of 2026-10-03
routed, not a VLAN · keyed peers only
bridge mode · its Wi-Fi radio unused
pfSense CE · HP ProDesk 600 G4 Mini · rack U5
Kea DHCP on the six VLANs (none on LAN)
Unbound, forwarding to AdGuard on trinity
NUT server: orderly shutdown on mjolnir
Dynamic DNS for the WireGuard endpoint
rdr UDP → phoenix, the one inbound pass
802.1Q trunk: igc0 → port 1 · LAN untagged · VLANs 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 99 tagged
on LAN · neo.matrix.elysium · UI plain HTTP
Port map lives on the wiki (infrastructure/switching)
shelf: TP-Link 8-port, on a UPS outlet
Off the rack: prometheus, oracle and trinity
on shelves; smaug in the media room, on the
PDU by a long cord; eeros through the house.
Reaches: internet, and trinity → bifrost on 80/443.
Hicks reaches it on named ports only.
UPS · rack U1–U2 · web UI on 443
HP ProDesk 600 G4 DM · Ubuntu · LUKS + TPM
Vaultwarden, ntfy and the household's apps
Alloy agents push metrics and logs to prometheus.
Node scrape: smaug. Blackbox: AdGuard, the wiki,
Grafana, ntfy and the UPS card.
Trusted workstations · by role, not owner
Reaches: internet, all of 30, and a
ASUS ROG Strix X570-E · Windows 11 · wired
ASUS ROG Crosshair VIII · Windows 11 · wired
Corporate laptops get the same rules
as everything else on this segment.
Inbound to smaug only, on named ports
neo port 15, untagged · PVID 40 · media room
Reaches: internet. Host passes: Saruman → prometheus
9090/3100, Saruman → smaug NFS. Hicks reaches all of it;
WireGuard peers land via phoenix and reach the lab only.
HPE ProLiant DL360 Gen9 · rack U3 · 2 × E5-2680 v3 · 128 GB
second server for the range, not yet bought;
local API, used by Home Assistant
Everything else here is reached through
its vendor's cloud, or not at all.

svg.text: Source: docs/network.md is the authority for addresses and segments; docs/hardware.md for the rack. Withheld on purpose: WAN address, WireGuard endpoint and port, full MACs, owner-linked names, camera placement.
